verdict.rationale: Clerky is purpose-built for Delaware startup incorporation, with docs describing formation, stock issuance, and legal dashboards, and extensive first-hand community testimonials confirming successful end-to-end incorporation completed fully online (often same-day) using Clerky instead of competitors like Stripe Atlas. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming bylaws and initial board consent/approval as generated documents, and no independent audit of the full document set beyond general 'incorporation' claims.
